name: Old Murk-Eye
summary: Old Murk-Eye is an infamous, battle-hardened murloc prowling the southern coastline of Westfall. Revered among his kind and feared by coastal sailors, he serves as a lethal menace to anyone wandering near the Westfall Lighthouse.

sections.title: Terror of the Coastline
sections.body: While murlocs are a common pest along the shores of Westfall, Old Murk-Eye stands apart from the lesser scavengers. Considerably tougher and far more aggressive than his kin, this grizzled beast prowls the surf surrounding the Westfall Lighthouse. His continued presence has caused enough grief to local mariners that the spectral Captain Grayson seeks his death, offering a bounty for the creature's pristine scales to break his grip on the shallows.

aliases: where to find old murk eye
faq.answer: He patrols the sandy shores and shallow waters of southwestern Westfall, directly along the coast near the Westfall Lighthouse.

faq.q: Why does Captain Grayson want Old Murk-Eye dead?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson considers Old Murk-Eye a persistent threat to the coastal waters. To curb the violence along the beach, he places a bounty on the legendary murloc, demanding a scale as proof of the deed.

faq.q: Is Old Murk-Eye different from ordinary murlocs?
faq.answer: Yes. He is notably stronger, more durable, and more aggressive than the Coastrunner and Tidehunter lackeys surrounding him, acting as a tribal champion among the local shoreline packs.

angles.text: For Alliance adventurers clearing out Westfall, eliminating Old Murk-Eye removes a notorious predator that preys on stranded travelers and ship crews.
